commonPatterns.dataRetrieval: All 3 screens use EntityManager.createNativeQuery() with raw SQL strings built via StringBuilder/String concatenation. No Spring Data repositories or named queries. SQL parameters are concatenated directly (SQL injection risk).
commonPatterns.rendering: All use inner ListitemRenderer classes that cast result to Object[] and create Listcell elements sequentially by index.
commonPatterns.excelExport: All export via Apache POI HSSF (old .xls format) with manual cell creation, styling, and Filedownload.save(AMedia).
commonPatterns.filtering: All share the same empresa/localidad filter pattern with AvEmpresasDAOJpaImpl and JPAQuerys.getListItemsDimensionEUser.
commonPatterns.noCharts: None of the 3 screens use ZK Charts (no CategoryModel, PieModel, etc.). They are pure tabular reports with footer totals.
commonPatterns.roleFilter: iiddmcustom = 1 (Personal/Rotacion) or c_rol IN ('A','B','C','D','G','P') (Rotacion mensual via av_colaboradores_mensual)
